x: On the 19th November we had Woodford Green A.C. and the Royal Military Police (Woking) as visitors to Belgrave Hall, for an 8 aside match over our 5 miles cross-country course. Bromley of the Police was first man home just in front of Vern Blowfield and Jack Brown.
Vern Blowfield had an easy run in fourth position and it looks as if these three will form the spearhead of our team for the coming cross-country championships.

At the half-distance there was a group of four runners with Brown, Blowfield, Bill Lucas and Steve Charlton all nicely together in under the half-hour, which is good running for our five miles course.
Vern Blowfield was our next runner, and behind him were Woodford Green, Essex Beagles and Aylesford, battling together, and the latter two clubs were represented by J.

The other members finished as follows:—Charlton 16th, Tobin 33rd, Ken Stimpson 45th, MacDonald 59th, Heard 68th and Housego 127th. The team finished fifth, quite a good performance without such stars as Burfitt, Blowfield and Smart.

Blowfield and Jack Brown were now in the thirties with Walker and Eddie Short also inside the fifty's, but our last two scoring men were still much too far back to stand a chance of securing a place in the team race.
